Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 02-Jan-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  THIRD SEMESTER B.Tech. (INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY) EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2024 / JANUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: ICT 2122/ICT_2122 - OBJECT ORIENTED PROGRAMMING  
  (MAKEUP)  
  
  
  OBJECT ORIENTED PROGRAMMING [ICT 2122]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)                Write a java program to perform the order processing functionalities. The application comprises of      (5)  
  class Order(int orderId, Product[] products, int[] orderedQuantity) and class Product (int productID,  
  int quantity, String productName). Override the equals() to ensure duplicate productid doesn't get  
  created. When placing an order, generate the orderId only if the orderedQuantity is less than the  
  available quantity. Override toString() method to display the product details of the generated  
  orderId.  
1B)                For the given code snippet, predict the output. If the typecasting is changed from int to boolean,      (3)  
  what will be the output.  
  public class typecasting  
  
  
1C)                Predict the output for the given code snippet.                                                          (2)  
  
  
  Page 1 of 4

2A)   Write a java program to implement a Ticket Booking System for various types of bookings, such as (5)  
  Movie Tickets, and Train Tickets. The system should manage and cancel recent bookings using a  
  stack data structure (LIFO - Last In, First Out), where the most recent booking is cancelled first.  
  Each type of ticket is inherited from a common Ticket superclass with methods booking and cancel,  
  that follows a specific booking and cancellation policy respectively, which should be implemented  
  using inheritance and method overriding. The system must keep track of the number of tickets in  
  each category and the name of the Movie or Train. Define a Stack class to maintain all ticket types  
  using push() and pop() methods. Booking happens when the ticket is pushed and cancel happens  
  when the Ticket is popped. Implementation should showcase inheritance, polymorphism, method  
  overriding, and dynamic method dispatch.  
2B)   Design a Java program with an abstract class Vehicle that has a final variable representing the     (3)  
  number of wheels, a final method fuelType() returning the fuel type, and an abstract method move().  
  Create subclasses Car and Bike that implement move() with specific behaviors, using the super  
  keyword to access the final variable in the Vehicle class. Demonstrate the functionality by  
  instantiating both Car and Bike in the main method and calling their methods.  
2C)   Justify the output of the following code snippet:                                                   (2)  
  
  
  Page 2 of 4

3A)   Create a class student with members: Name, RegNo and 3 subject marks. Compute the result                (5)  
  based on the average of marks. If the average is less than 40, result is fail else pass. Raise a user  
  defined exception InvalidStdDataException to check for empty name, regno within 1- 75 and each  
  subject mark within 0-100 . Write a java program to create a student array of size 5 and display the  
  details in tabular form.  
3B)   Define a package called 'items' and define a public interface Item in this package as follows.          (3)  
  
  
  Define a public class Book with the following data members namely, title, author, ISBN, in the  
  'library' package, implementing Item interface. Create a main class in the package 'library', to  
  demonstrate the Book object with interface method. Specify filenames, package names, and  
  imports. Do use the same naming convention as asked in the question.  
3C)   Write the output for the following code snippet and justify your answer.                                (2)  
  
  
  Page 3 of 4

4A)   Implement a java program to create five threads, the first thread checking the uniqueness of matrix    (5)  
  elements, the second calculating row sum, the third calculating the column sum, the fourth  
  calculating principal diagonal sum, the fifth calculating the secondary diagonal sum of a given  
  matrix. The main thread reads a square matrixfrom keyboard and will display whether the given  
  matrix is magic square or not by obtaining the required data from sub threads  
4B)   Explain the creation of Java class and Java method using generics. Give examples                       (3)  
4C)   Explain join() method and wait() method with example                                                   (2)  
5A)   Create a simple sign-up form in JavaFX where the user enters a username. When they click               (5)  
  "Submit," it should display "Valid username" if the username has at least 5 characters, and "Invalid  
  username" otherwise. How would you check the username length in JavaFX? Which components  
  would you use to display the result message?  
5B)   According to CERT Rule ERR07-J Why is it discouraged to throw RuntimeException, Exception, or (3)  
  Throwable in Java. Explain  
5C)   Explain the various layout panes used in any JavaFX application.                                       (2)
